caption: The message is padded and cut into blocks; each block is mixed with the running chaining value, and the final chaining value is the digest. Notice the dashed edge: the same compression step repeats for every block.

spec.title: Merkle–Damgård hashing
spec.aria: The message is padded and split into fixed blocks; each block is compressed with the running chaining value, and the last chaining value becomes the fixed-length digest.
